content.user_title: Reduce SaaS Churn With Retention Flows
content.value_statement: Customers cancel for different reasons, and failed payments create avoidable revenue loss. This skill builds cancellation flows, save offers, health scoring, and payment recovery plans.
actual_capabilities: Designs staged cancel flows with survey, offer, confirmation, and post-cancel steps.
Maps cancellation reasons to discounts, pauses, downgrades, outreach, and support actions.
Creates payment recovery plans with pre-dunning, retry timing, emails, and grace periods.
Defines churn risk signals, health scores, and proactive retention interventions.
Recommends churn metrics, cohort cuts, and cancel-flow tests for measurement.
Provides provider-specific notes for Stripe, Chargebee, Paddle, Recurly, and Braintree.
limitations: It does not implement billing provider APIs or deploy retention tooling.
Compliance guidance is general and must be reviewed for each jurisdiction.
Recommendations need product, pricing, billing, and usage context to be accurate.
Full win-back email writing is better handled by a dedicated email sequence skill.

use_cases.title: Design a Cancel Flow
use_cases.description: Create a user-friendly cancellation path with reason capture, targeted offers, and clear confirmation.

use_cases.title: Recover Failed Payments
use_cases.description: Plan card expiry alerts, smart retries, dunning emails, and grace periods for subscription billing.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Retention Work
use_cases.description: Use churn signals, cohorts, and save-rate metrics to choose the next retention experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Basic Cancel Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new cancellation experience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a cancel flow for our subscription product. Ask for any missing details, then propose the survey, save offer, confirmation, and post-cancel steps.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Failed Payment Recovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on involuntary churn.
prompt_templates.prompt: We lose customers after failed payments. Create a dunning plan with expiry reminders, retry timing, customer messages, grace period rules, and recovery metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Segment Save Offers
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using cancellation reason and customer data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these cancel reasons, plans, tenure groups, and MRR levels, map the best save offer for each segment and explain what to test first.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Retention System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete churn prevention program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a full churn prevention strategy for our SaaS business. Include health scoring, proactive interventions, cancel-flow experiments, dunning, metrics, and a 90-day rollout.

output_examples.input: We have instant cancellation and want to save more customers.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes a five-step flow: trigger, exit survey, dynamic offer, confirmation, and post-cancel follow-up. It maps common reasons to discounts, pauses, downgrades, support escalation, or no offer.

output_examples.input: Expired cards cause a large part of our churn.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends card expiry reminders before failure, smart retries after declines, four dunning emails, a grace period, and provider setup checks.

output_examples.input: We want to find at-risk accounts before they cancel.
output_examples.output: The skill defines churn signals such as login drops, stopped feature use, support issues, billing visits, and NPS changes. It turns them into risk tiers and intervention actions.

best_practices: Provide churn rate, customer count, pricing, billing provider, and current cancellation process before asking for a plan.
Separate voluntary churn from failed-payment churn, because each needs a different workflow.
Keep cancellation clear and compliant while testing save offers and measuring long-term retention.
anti_patterns: Do not hide cancellation controls or force unnecessary contact before cancellation.
Do not show the same discount to every cancellation reason.
Do not count a short-term save as success without tracking later churn and lifetime value.

faq.question: What kind of churn does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers voluntary cancellation, failed-payment churn, proactive risk signals, save offers, and retention measurement.

faq.question: Can it design a cancellation survey?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends reason categories, survey structure, free-text capture, and follow-up actions tied to each reason.

faq.question: Does it write dunning emails?
faq.answer: It provides dunning timing, message goals, and template structure. Final copy should match your brand and legal needs.

faq.question: Can it connect to Stripe or Chargebee?
faq.answer: No. It gives setup guidance, but it does not authenticate, configure, or call billing provider APIs.

faq.question: Is the compliance advice complete?
faq.answer: No. It gives general reminders only. Review cancellation and payment rules with qualified counsel for your markets.

faq.question: What inputs make results better?
faq.answer: Share churn rates, cancellation reasons, plan prices, billing intervals, usage signals, customer segments, and current recovery performance.
